Support Us贊助我們

Patreon

Becoming a Patreon supporter gives you access to our new game development journals, as well as early releases of new concept art, game animations, and more.

成為Patreon贊助者，可以看到我們新遊戲開發誌、以及新的概念美術、遊戲動畫搶先釋出……等等。



This Valentine DLC is a short special story that follows Ending 4-4, "Madman's Home," from Bloody Painter Dating Sim, with a playtime of only 20 minutes.

Please complete this ending in the MAIN GAME before playing this DLC.

This DLC features a heartwarming and sweet story, with four new CGs and full voice acting.

We have also made major updates to the game system, including larger UI text for better mobile accessibility and animated character sprites.

此情人節DLC為《血腥畫家戀愛遊戲》結局4-4「瘋子之家」後續衍生短篇特別劇情，時長僅20分鐘。

遊玩本DLC之前請先通關過 本篇遊戲此結局。

本DLC劇情為溫馨甜蜜向、有4張新CG圖、全配音。

我們對遊戲系統做了大更新、放大介面文字使手機用戶更好操作，並替角色立繪加上動畫。 


🍫 Story 故事 🍫

You’ve been living with a serial killer for a while now. 

As someone of the same kind, it doesn't feel unnatural to you.

Today is Valentine's Day. Has he prepared anything for the occasion…?

你跟殺人魔同居一段時間了，身為同類、這並不會讓你感到不自在。

今天是情人節，他是否會有所準備呢……？
